verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some user control over the storage lifecycle. Volumes are persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be managed from the Storage page. The CLI workflow also includes a 'clean up' step for instance teardown. Together these imply users can choose whether data persists or is destroyed. Nothing documents explicit retention policies, deletion guarantees, or data handling on third-party hosts. missing for 10: documented retention settings, verified data wiping on host machines after instance or volume deletion, account/data deletion controls, independent corroboration.
